scope: Installed Rust 1.95.0 rust-src core/src and alloc/src regular .rs files plus both Cargo.toml files
selection: Complete inventory within scope, no similarity ranking or outcome-based selection
identity: Record compiler -Vv, sysroot, installed rust-src manifest, file bytes/SHA256 and computed Git blob ID; compiler commit is an association, not proof every local source file matches upstream
archive: Deterministic zip in ignored originals; only inventory, hashes and metadata public by default
prior_exposure: Unknown for every file; compare exact SHA256 with frozen xkernel source corpus, but no exact match does not establish independence
license: Record Cargo license declarations, no certification of every file or redistribution grant
gates: No test eligibility until upstream identity, exposure, semantic families and observation scope are checked; no relation labels or doc completeness inferred
stop: Inventory and verify archive/hash consistency; no toolchain changes, source execution or effectiveness evaluation
